claude_only.name: Which registry-assigned code is the authoritative master identifier for this venue, and is it an operating or a segment code?
Which governed global identifier resolves the legal entity that operates the venue, and how is it kept current?
In which country and city does the venue operate for registry purposes, and how does that differ from where its matching engine runs?
What registry status does the code carry, and on which dates was it created, last updated and last validated?
Under which authorisation class does the venue operate, and which authority granted or designated it?
What authorisation states are valid for this venue, and which evidenced event moves it between them?
From which instant is each authorisation state effective, and when was that fact observed by this model?
Which jurisdictions recognise this venue for their own regulatory purposes, and on what basis?
Which segments and order books compose this venue, and which identifier is authoritative at each level?
Which market-category classification applies to each segment, and under which scheme version?
How does an agent distinguish a segment of this venue from a separate venue operated by the same entity?
Which rulebook version governs trading at a given instant, and what was the immediately preceding version?
Which document or filing is the authoritative published statement of how this venue operates?
Who owns the venue, who operates it, and which conflicts of interest are disclosed between operator, affiliates and participants?
Which role holds authority to change the rulebook, and which role merely stewards this model's record of it?
Which venue-assigned code identifies this participant, and which external identifiers resolve the same party?
Which membership category and trading capacities does the participant hold on this venue?
Which participants access the venue indirectly through another member, and how is that tier recorded?
Which participation criteria applied at the time of the decision, and were they objective, risk-based and publicly disclosed?
What decision was reached, by which role, on which evidence, and what recourse exists against it?
Which membership states are valid, and which evidenced event moves the participant between them?
Under what conditions may access be withdrawn immediately, and what safe state applies while the decision is pending?
Through which access channels does this participant reach the venue, and which of them are sponsored or direct electronic access?
Which segments, order books, products and order types is each channel entitled to use?
How is an order traced from the access channel back to the accountable member and decision maker?
What controls protect the venue when a channel misbehaves, and how is the intervention recorded?
Which standing quoting obligations has this participant accepted, and for which instruments and phases?
How is compliance with the commitment measured, over what window, and against which threshold?
Under which exceptional market conditions is the obligation suspended, and how is that declared?
Which flag marks an order or trade as submitted under a liquidity provision activity?
Which external identifier resolves the object admitted to trading, and which classification accompanies it?
From which instant is the object tradable on which segment, and when does admission terminate?
Which venue-specific trading parameters attach to the admission rather than to the object itself?
Which product reference data must the venue supply before trading may commence, and to whom?
Which identifiers make an order uniquely resolvable within the venue and across a reporting chain?
Which price and quantity attributes must be held, and how are undisclosed portions represented?
Which attributes express the order's conditions and intent rather than its economics?
Which fields are mandatory for every order and which are conditional on the trading model?
Which forms of trading interest does this venue accept besides firm orders, and how is each defined?
Which timestamp granularity and clock tolerance applies to a request-for-quote or negotiated interest as opposed to an electronic order?
How is a quote's lifecycle bounded, and what happens on expiry, withdrawal or non-response?
Which event types change an order's state, and which resulting status does each produce?
How is the ordering of events guaranteed when two events carry the same timestamp?
Which timestamps are recorded per event, and how are event time and ingestion time kept apart?
How is a superseded order state preserved when an order is amended?
What determines an order's position in the queue, and which attribute records it?
What exactly does a book state record capture, and is it a snapshot or a derived reconstruction?
Which parts of the book are displayed to participants and which are not?
Which named phases exist in a session, and in which order do they run for each segment?
Which days are trading days for this venue, and which are holidays or partial sessions?
How does the venue treat activity outside regular trading hours?
Which phase was in force when a given order event or trade occurred?
Which matching algorithm applies to each order book and phase, and how are fills allocated?
Is execution non-discretionary, and where discretion exists, how is it constrained and disclosed?
Which orders may not match each other, and why?
How would an independent party verify that a published fill followed the stated algorithm?
Which automatic controls constrain price movement, and against which reference price are they measured?
Which halt and suspension states exist, and what evidence records entry to and exit from each?
Under what emergency authority may the operator intervene beyond the automatic controls, and how is that recorded?
What is the safe state when the matching system itself fails, and how is participant interest treated?
Which official prices does this venue produce, and by which published method is each derived?
What is the status of a published price, and how is a provisional value distinguished from a final one?
When was the price effective, and when was it published and observed?
Where a downstream benchmark or index consumes this price, what does the venue assert and what does it not?
Which pre-trade information must be made public, and which waiver removes or limits that duty?
Which fields constitute a post-trade publication, and which flags qualify it?
Under what conditions may publication be deferred, and when does the deferred detail become public?
On what terms is market data supplied, and how is non-discriminatory access evidenced?
Which identifier is authoritative for the trade, and which order and member records does it link back to?
Which economic terms does the venue assert at execution?
Which timestamps must be recorded, and at which granularity?
What does the venue assert about the trade, and what does it explicitly not assert?
On what grounds may the venue amend or cancel an executed trade, and within what window?
How is the original trade preserved when a correction is issued?
Which flag signals a cancellation or amendment to consumers of the venue's published data?
What evidence supports a cancellation decision, and how long must it be retained?
Which clearing arrangement applies to a trade on this segment, and which infrastructure is named?
At what point does the venue's responsibility end and the clearing infrastructure's begin?
Which pre-execution checks does the venue perform on clearing eligibility, and what happens on failure?
Which settlement or delivery terms does the venue assert at the moment of execution?
When the venue records a downstream status, what marks it as an observation rather than an authoritative fact?
How is a conflict between the venue's asserted terms and the peer infrastructure's record resolved?
Which downstream statuses are meaningful to record here, and which must never be inferred?
Which conduct prohibitions apply to activity on this venue, and from which instrument do they derive?
Which inside-information disclosure duty applies to participants, and what role does the venue play in it?
How does an agent tell whether a conduct rule is a venue rule or a statutory rule the venue merely restates?
Which version of the conduct rule set applied to a given event?
What monitoring arrangement does the venue declare, over which activity, and which function operates it?
By which reference is a matter handed to an investigating or enforcing body, and what does this model retain?
Which surveillance details must not be disclosed, and to whom may the arrangement be described?
How does the venue evidence that the declared arrangement was in force at a given time?
Which retention period applies to each class of venue record, and which instrument sets it?
Which clock divergence tolerance and timestamp granularity apply to this venue, and on what basis?
How is traceability to Coordinated Universal Time documented and reviewed?
Which party executes disposition when a retention period ends, and what does this model retain afterwards?
Which exception classes does the venue record, and what interim treatment applies to each?
How is a participant dispute recorded, and where does its resolution live?
Which data must the venue supply to which authority, under which legal basis and on what deadline?
Who may see an open exception record, and under what minimum-disclosure projection?

grok_only.name: What four-character ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code currently identifies this market, segment or trade-reporting facility?
Is this MIC an operating-level code (OPRT) or a market-segment code (SGMT)?
What operating MIC is the parent of this code, and is this record itself the operating MIC?
What market name-institution description, legal entity name and facility acronym are published for this MIC?
What ISO 10383 status, last-update date and expiry date apply to this MIC, and when did the Registration Authority last publish versus make the change effective?
Which ISO 10383 market category code is assigned to this MIC, and is that code semantically empty (NSPD or OTHR)?

Under the governing legal system, is this facility a trading venue (RM, MTF or OTF), a US national securities exchange, an ATS operating under an exchange exemption, a DCM, a SEF, a MiCA crypto-asset trading platform, a trade-reporting facility, or a systematic internaliser?
If the MIC category is SINT, APPA, ARMS or CTPS, what evidence shows the facility is not a multilateral trading venue, and which sibling model owns SI quoting or DRSP operations?
Which foreign or home-register classes are claimed as equivalent or substituted (for example SEF versus OTF, ATS versus MTF), and what primary evidence supports or contradicts that alignment?
Does this facility operate a multilateral system in which multiple third-party buying and selling interests can interact in the system under its rules so that a contract can result?

Are interests matched under non-discretionary rules (RM or MTF) or may the operator use discretion (OTF), and is own-account matching of third-party interests prohibited in the way a venue is prohibited from acting as an SI?
What observations, with method, time and confidence, distinguish this facility from an adjacent class such as broker crossing, bulletin board, e-commerce catalogue, CCP, or DRSP?
If the US Exchange Act definition applies, which premises, property rights, communication systems and reporting facilities are included as facilities of this exchange?
Which competent authority, commission or self-regulatory organisation granted, refused, suspended or withdrew the right to operate this market, and under which statutory provision?
What is the current authorisation or designation state of the venue, and on what event-time did that state become effective as distinct from when this record ingested the fact?

Which venue core principles or operating-condition titles apply (for example MiFID Title II or III, CEA 23 DCM principles, 15 SEF principles, MiCA Article 76), without copying the authority's assessment of compliance?
What is the home Member State or home jurisdiction of the market operator, and in which host jurisdictions is the venue passported, notice-registered or otherwise accessible?

What MIC-status transition is being recorded (creation, update of details, deactivation/expiry), who was entitled to request it, and what are the RA publication date and modification implementation date?

Has trading occurred on this designated contract market in the last twelve consecutive calendar months, is the 36-month new-market grace still running, or has designation been vacated, and at what event-times?
If this Dimension record is retired, will the MIC be tombstoned rather than hard-deleted, and which adopting-Dimension retention policy executes destruction of any extra local attributes?
What LEI and legal entity name identify the organisation that operates this market, and is the market operator the same legal person as the market itself?
In which ISO country and municipality does this market operate, and does it operate in more than one location?
What public website or other official channel is published on the MIC record for this market?
What role does the referenced legal person play (market operator, segment operator, reporting-facility operator) without importing that person's corporate lifecycle?
Which segment MICs are part of this operating market, and which operating MIC does this segment belong to?
Is this facility an auction market, quote-driven market, dark pool, off-book reporting facility, electronic communication network, floor segment, or another specialised facility?
Which referenced instruments, contracts or crypto-assets are admitted to trading or listed under this market's rules, and what is each admission state and effective event-time?
For a given admitted instrument, is this MIC the place of official listing, a place of trade, both, or neither (reporting-only)?
Which central counterparties, if any, are designated for contracts executed on this market, and what subject-specific parameters (eligible product set, account model) are venue-side only?
Which CSD, SSS or payment system is designated for settlement of venue trades, and does this venue claim on-chain, off-chain or hybrid settlement initiation without owning settlement finality?
To which trade repository, APA, ARM, CTP or other reporting facility must trades on this market be reported, and which of those destinations have their own MICs?

What membership or participant classes exist (member, participant, sponsor, DEA user, retail, eligible contract participant), and which referenced parties currently hold each class without copying those parties' KYC records?
Are access rules transparent, non-discriminatory and based on objective criteria, or does an OTF or other class lawfully restrict access, and where is that stated?
Does the venue offer direct electronic access or co-location, and are those services offered on published non-discriminatory terms?
Which participants are currently suspended or excluded from trading on this venue, at what event-time, and under which rule, without storing the disciplinary case file?
What is the trading calendar, session schedule and time zone of this market, and which referenced business-calendar exceptions (holidays, early closes) currently apply?

What is the current operational trading state (scheduled-open, auction, continuous, halted, volatility-interrupt, emergency-closed, ended-for-day) and at what event-time did it start versus when was it observed?
What pre-trade and post-trade transparency obligations, waivers and deferrals apply to this venue, including dark or delayed publication?

What venue-level activity or liquid-market indicators are recorded (session count, participant count, halt count, declared liquid-market flags for instrument classes), with method, event-time, observation-time and confidence, and without importing order-by-order statistics owned by the trade model?
What matching or execution protocol does the venue advertise (continuous order book, periodic auction, RFQ, quote-driven, hybrid), without claiming ownership of individual match events?
What is the current rulebook or operating-rules identifier and version for this market, who issued it, and when did it become effective?
What emergency authorities may the venue exercise (halt, position-limit change, liquidation-only, cancel orders) and what preconditions does the rulebook state, without executing those powers here?

What declared hazards and failure modes does the venue document (disorderly trading, capacity overload, erroneous-order storms, manipulation susceptibility of listed contracts) and what venue-side controls or safe states are claimed?
What recordkeeping and clock-synchronisation obligations apply to this venue as a facility, and which adopting-Dimension or referenced audit model stores the actual audit trail?
From which authoritative register extract was this market record populated, at what publication and implementation times, and who observed or ingested it into this Dimension?
What additional identifiers (FIBO IRI, national register code, operating MIC plus segment pair, local Dimension UUID or ULID) identify this same market, and which is master versus alias?
What explicit conformance or alignment claims are made (ISO 10383, MiFID trading venue, SEA exchange, CEA DCM, MiCA platform, FIBO Exchange) and which remain unproven?

Which fields of this market record are public register data versus owner-gated operating detail, so a minimum-disclosure projection can omit member lists, emergency playbooks and unpublished halt reasons?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
